configurations.label: 22 disks: D7 core-root source candidate

radius.exact_definition: r=sqrt(t), where t is the unique root of 29*t^3-55*t^2+19*t-1 in (641/10000,321/5000). The source radius-link record identifies this with the full core root.

configurations.coordinate_definition: theta=2*pi/7, c=cos(theta), s=sin(theta), a=2*r*cos(theta/2), X=(1+4*a^2-r^2)/(4*a), Y=-(1-c)*(1-r^2)/(4*a*s), e=(X,-Y); R rotates by theta. Center formulas below use the exact linked radius r. The source core-root extract independently supplies drawing-coordinate enclosures: node j is (z[2j-2],z[2j-1]), z in xnum/Qx +/- 10^-80. Boundary anchors and auxiliary face witnesses are not centers.
